title: World War I
subtitle: Understand the years. Follow the stories.

events.title: Before the storm
events.description: Start with everyday life and the tensions gathering beneath it. This fictional opening gives the later stories their context.

events.title: The breaking point
events.description: A crisis becomes a conflict. Follow the choices that turn distant politics into an immediate reality.

events.title: A war takes shape
events.description: The first expectations give way to a longer struggle. The front and the home front begin to change each other.

events.title: The long middle
events.description: Little seems to move, but the cost keeps growing. Look at the same phase through different people's lives.

events.title: The balance shifts
events.description: A new development changes what each side believes is possible. One story returns here after a gap in its main plot.

events.title: The final push
events.description: Exhaustion and urgency collide as the conflict approaches its end. Two stories cover this phase from different angles.

events.title: When the fighting stops
events.description: The end of combat does not instantly restore ordinary life. Close with the immediate aftermath and what people carry home.

entries.title: The Last Summer Orchard
entries.premise: A family reunion becomes a farewell as a quiet border town hears the first news of conflict.
entries.learn: How a conflict interrupts ordinary lives, and why the world before the fighting matters.
entries.coverageNote: The main story spans 1900–1901. A brief old-age epilogue in 1940 is excluded.

entries.title: Letters from the Eastern Road
entries.premise: A messenger follows a changing front while letters home tell a very different story.
entries.learn: How early expectations become a sustained struggle, seen across several years.
entries.coverageNote: All three episodes belong to the suggested watch. Their main stories cover 1901–1903.

entries.title: A Winter Without Maps
entries.premise: An isolated unit and a nearby village wait through a winter that seems to have no end.
entries.learn: The human experience of a stalemate, rather than an overview of campaigns.
entries.coverageNote: The main plot takes place entirely in 1903. A short opening memory is excluded.

entries.title: The Bridge Between Us
entries.premise: Two engineers meet during the first campaigns, then reunite for a decisive crossing years later.
entries.learn: How the same place can reveal changes between the early and late phases of a conflict.
entries.coverageNote: Substantial story sections occur in 1902 and 1904–1905. The intervening year is not shown as covered.

entries.title: The Morning After Silence
entries.premise: A nurse and a returning soldier try to find their way home as news of peace travels ahead of them.
entries.learn: The difference between the end of fighting and the beginning of recovery.
entries.coverageNote: The final fighting and immediate aftermath, 1905–1906, are both central to the plot.
